d:
Chanaky dharavahik matr manoranjan ke lie hi nahin balki aam jan ko shikshit karne ke uddeshy se bhi utna hi mahatvapurn hai.
Is adhyay men -
Apne guptachar shishupal ki hatya se mahamantri shaktar vichlit hain. aadhi rat ke bad achanak mahamantri na jane kahan chale gae.unki patni chintagrast ho shaktar ke mitr milind ke ghar jakar unhen shaktar ko khoj lane ki guhar lagati hai. dusri or mahamantri shaktar gusse men beqabu ho kar raja dhannand dvara zamin men garhi gayi svarn mudraon ko raste par bikher dete hain.
